The '''Koobi system''', also known as the '''Nelvaan system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the world of [[Nelvaan/Legends|Nelvaan]], [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Nelvaanian/Legends|Nelvaanian]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Koobi system was given its first mention in the [[Star Wars Legends]] continuity in.the [[2005]] novel ''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]'' written by [[James Luceno]]. While referred to as the Nelvaan system in that source, the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank's]] entry on the Nelvaanian species refers to it as the Koobi system. Varying sources have since used both names.
